ap.rare_positive_caution: Positive FPC baseline can retain every observed positive in every replicate; valid replicates or zero spread do not prove coverage.

workload.interval_caveat: Design-normal approximation can under-cover with rare/zero observed findings; zero sample variance is not evidence of absent unsampled findings. Logical bounds remain separate.
Design-normal approximation can under-cover with rare/zero observed findings; zero sample variance is not evidence of absent unsampled findings. Logical bounds remain separate.
Design-normal approximation can under-cover with rare/zero observed findings; zero sample variance is not evidence of absent unsampled findings. Logical bounds remain separate.

limitations: Nonlinear AP plug-in is not unbiased
AP percentile and workload normal intervals are design approximations without established rare-positive coverage
Unknown reference outcomes never deleted or treated as known negatives
No new-project/family confidence interval or model-training uncertainty
No cross-class paired inference: file-by-class sample overlaps need separate covariance treatment
Complete successful full-queue scores required; failed-score fallback is not implemented
